messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Tom,

Please find our client's Defence, served today. In summary: latent compressor defect on the first consignment; causation and total loss put in issue on both; and reliance on clause 11.3 as a reasonable, freely negotiated allocation of risk.

Regards,
Nadia Iqbal
Pemberton Rowe LLP

messages.subject: FW: Defence - Hartwell v Cryovance (CL-2026-000214)
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah - Defence in. As expected they hang everything on 11.3 and put us to proof on causation/total loss. The 'latent defect' point on consignment 1 doesn't touch consignment 2 (driver switched the unit off), which keeps our pattern argument intact. I'll send our directions letter and push for disclosure of the CAPA and tachograph records. Drafting the chronology and Stephen's statement now.

Tom

--
Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
